newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Six Dubai cargoes offered for Indian crude tender.
newsitem.headline: Six Dubai cargoes offered for Indian crude tender.

text.p: At least six cargoes of Dubai crude oil have been offered into India's import tender for December crude, traders said on Friday.
The tender closed on Thursday and awards are expected to be made later on Friday.
The tender sought a range of crudes, including Far East, Middle East and West African grades.
Traders said the six cargoes of Dubai were offered at first half month quotes plus a premium of 57 to 63 cents. Those offering were two European majors, a U.S. trader and a Wall Street trader.

A Japanese trader offered a cargo of Oman crude at MPM +11 cents, while a U.S. major and a trader offered Gulf of Suez crude at the official selling price plus three cents and minus five cents respectively.
A U.S. major offered two very large crude carriers (VLCC) of Qua Iboe. The first was offered at dated Brent +$1.17 per barrel and the second at BBQ quotes plus 60 cents.
A Swiss trader offered two VLCCs of Qua Iboe at dated Brent plus $1.24 and plus $1.28 respectively.
